presentation: ScreenshotFocus displays selected rectangular regions in source-image pixels. Disjoint settings are presented as separate crops. The stored screenshot pixels and SHA-256 hashes remain unchanged; clicking a crop opens the source screenshot in the image viewer.
scope: Screenshots of the explicitly named installed builds. Historical Android screenshots were replaced with physical-device settings captures. Screenshot values are not universal recommendations. No simulated product interfaces or AI-generated UI screenshots.
